barcode-background.$description: Barcode: the white plate behind the bars, the quiet zone and the line under them (white in both themes, as the QR code’s plate: scanners read dark on light; the owner, 2026-10-13).

barcode-bar.$description: Barcode: the black bars (black in both themes: the media roles do not follow the theme).

barcode-text.$description: Barcode: the human-readable line under the bars, on the plate, in the bars’ black (readable in both themes).

barcode-font-family.$description: Barcode: the human-readable line is a technical value, in the data font.

barcode-font-size.$description: Barcode: the size of the human-readable line and of the invalid-value message.

barcode-line-height.$description: Barcode: the line height of the human-readable line.

barcode-row-gap.$description: Barcode: the space between the bars and the line under them.

barcode-padding-block.$description: Barcode: the surface above the bars and below the line (the quiet zone at the sides is part of the drawing).

barcode-sm-height.$description: Barcode: the height of the bars at size sm (a dense label).

barcode-md-height.$description: Barcode: the height of the bars at size md, the default (a narrow bar of 2px).

barcode-lg-height.$description: Barcode: the height of the bars at size lg (a code scanned from the screen).

barcode-error-text.$description: Barcode: the message for a value the format cannot hold, in the danger color on the theme’s surface (as the error empty state’s icon).

barcode-invalid-background.$description: Barcode: a value the format cannot hold draws no code, so it sits on the theme’s surface, not on the white plate (its message keeps the danger color’s contrast in both themes).
